hints.content: The graph shows how the profit, $\blue{P}$, varies as a function of the number of hot dogs sold, $\red{n}$. We can use the graph of the function to complete the sentences.

The graph of the function is increasing. As $\red{n}$ increases, the profit, $\blue{P}$, will **increase**.

The slope of the graph is equal to $\purple{1}$.
For each hot dog sold, the profit increases by $\$\purple{1}$. This means Jimmy is selling the hot dogs for $\$\purple{1}$ each.

To complete the remaining three sentences, we can *read off the appropriate values* from the graph of the function. Observe that the graph of the function passes through the points $(\red{8},\blue{0})$, $(\red{15},\blue{7})$, and $(\red{20},\blue{12})$. Therefore, Jimmy needs to sell $\red{n=8}$ hot dogs to recover his investment (to break even), $\red{n=15}$ hot dogs to make a profit of $\blue{P=\$7}$, and $\red{n=20}$ hot dogs to make a profit of $\blue{P=\$12}$.

The correct way to complete the sentences is as follows:

- As Jimmy sells more hot dogs, 
his profit will ${\text{increase}}$.  
- Jimmy sells the hot dogs for $\${1}$ each.   
- Jimmy needs to sell ${8}$ hot dogs to recover the money he invested.  
- If Jimmy sells $15$ hot dogs, he will make $\${7}$ in profit.  
- To make $\$12$ in profit, Jimmy would have to sell ${20}$ hot dogs.

question.content:
Jimmy will be selling hot dogs at the football game. He bought hot dogs, buns, and condiments for a total of $\$8$ and now wants to calculate how many hot dogs he has to sell to make a profit. He graphs the profit he will make, $(P)$, as a function of the number of hot dogs sold, $(n)$.

**Complete the following sentences based on the graph of the function.**

* As Jimmy sells more hot dogs, 
his profit will [[☃ dropdown 1]].  
* Jimmy sells the hot dogs for $\$$[[☃ input-number 1]] each.   
* Jimmy needs to sell [[☃ input-number 2]] hot dogs to recover the money he invested.  
* If Jimmy sells $15$ hot dogs, he will make $\$$[[☃ input-number 3]] in profit.  
* To make $\$12$ in profit, Jimmy would have to sell [[☃ input-number 4]] hot dogs.

options.alt: An XY coordinate plane a line plotted.  The horizontal x axis represents the number of hot dogs sold, and runs from negative 2 to 21 in intervals of 1.  The vertical y axis represents the profit, in dollars, and runs from negative 9 to 13 in intervals of 1. The function increases as it moves left to right. The function passes through the points (0, negative 8), (8, 0), and (13, 5).
